substrate_status.command: uv run python -c 'from substrate.settings import load_workspace_config; from pathlib import Path; cfg=load_workspace_config(Path(".")); print("Repos:", sorted(cfg.repositories.keys()))'

disk_usage.description: Show disk usage of main mounts

git_pull_all.command: for d in /home/ahron/codespace/*/; do (cd "$d" && [ -d .git ] && echo "=== $(basename $d) ===" && git pull --ff-only 2>&1 | sed "s|^|[$(basename $d)] |"); done
git_pull_all.description: Pull all workspace repos in ff-only mode

git_status_all.command: for d in /home/ahron/codespace/*/; do (cd "$d" && [ -d .git ] && echo "=== $(basename $d) ===" && git status --short); done
git_status_all.description: Show dirty files across all workspace repos

ollama_models.command: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print("\n".join(m["name"] for m in d.get("models",[])))' || echo 'ollama not running'

kilo_status.command: systemctl --user status kilo-remote.service 2>&1 | head -10 && echo --- && systemctl --user status kilo-acp.service 2>&1 | head -10

agent_session.description: Run a one-shot Kilo agent task with the given prompt

headscale_links.command: tailscale status --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); self_node=d.get("SelfNode",{}); print("Hostname:", self_node.get("HostName")); print("Tailscale IPs:", self_node.get("Addresses")); print("MagicDNS:", self_node.get("Name"))' 2>/dev/null || echo 'tailscale not running'

proton_drive_status.command: rclone listremotes 2>&1 | grep protondrive && echo 'protondrive configured' || echo 'protondrive NOT configured - run automation/proton-setup.sh'

proton_mail_status.command: systemctl --user is-active protonmail-bridge 2>&1; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':1143|:1025' | head -3 || echo 'mail bridge not running'
